items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 33:1
items.html: (To the question) The Mochin of the front she receives from the Malchut of Ima, as above, Part 14, Answer 90, see there. And the Mochin of the posterior, of an equal stature with ZA, she receives from the NHY of Ima.
